## Problem and change

What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes?

## Testing

List the checks run and their results. Include service versions for relevant
integration tests and note any coverage gaps.

## Notes

Describe compatibility changes, documentation updates, or remaining limitations
that reviewers need to know about. Omit this section if none apply.

## Applicable procedures

Link applicable approved SOPs from the project procedure index and their evidence,
or explain why none apply. Distinguish proposed procedures from approved ones.

## Maintainer assessment

Before merging, record the maintainer's assessment of the final change, CI results,
and applicable procedure evidence. Independent PR approval is optional during the
sole-contributor phase; this assessment does not claim an independent review.
